title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
overview:
- 26 Immediately Playable Characters plus 4 Hidden Characters!
- The new Aggressor Kombat Mode arms the quick & merciless with more strength and power to inflict heavy, damaging combinations!
- Over 30 Moves and "-Alities" never seen in the arcade! New Brutalities let you pound opponents 'til they explode!
- New 3 on 3 Kombat Mode delivers a marathon fight-to-the-finish!
- 7 humiliating Stage Fatalities that send defeated opponents plummeting out of the arena to a grisly death!
